locations.label: Landing ridge
locations.sceneDescription: Wreckage lies below a low ridge, with the surviving habitat and cargo sled visible in the distance.
locations.renderScene: A low rusty Martian landing ridge in soft dawn dust. At the top distant horizon only, a few battered landing panels and a squat surviving habitat. The central and lower three quarters are smooth empty reddish regolith, a quiet working clearing. No radio, beacon or loose wreckage in the playfield.

locations.label: Landing habitat
locations.sceneDescription: The inner cabin is intact, but its outer vestibule is torn beside the sheltered ice and signal mast.
locations.renderScene: Inside a small surviving Mars habitat: pale insulated ribs, a recessed round window showing the red plain, the far side of a visibly torn outer vestibule only at the upper edge. The central and lower three quarters are clear muted grey cabin floor. No repaired airlock, seedlings, stored water, beacon, equipment or furnishings on the playable floor.

locations.label: Landing cargo yard
locations.sceneDescription: The cargo sled holds the rover and expedition field equipment beside a clear view of the route ahead.
locations.renderScene: A sheltered Mars cargo yard, a fixed landing skid and low parked unmodified rover silhouette confined to the distant upper edge, with an open horizon behind them. Central and lower area is empty compact red dust. No solar drive, harness, navigation map, tools or loose crates in the playfield.

locations.label: Ice outcrop
locations.sceneDescription: Exposed ice and layered cliffs interrupt the route; the only equipment here is the field kit we brought.

chapters.title: What the cliff can tell us

locations.renderScene: A Martian ice outcrop: a low blue-white ice seam cuts through rust-red layered cliff at the upper edge. Clear smooth dusty ground fills most of the picture below it. No sample, label, camera, core tube, map, tools, tracks or planted flags.

locations.label: Weather station
locations.sceneDescription: A disused instrument station stands on its apron with its service equipment still beside it.

locations.label: Disabled crawler

locations.renderScene: A disabled enclosed Mars crawler, intact cabin and dark windows at the distant upper edge beside a rocky outcrop. Wide smooth red-dust foreground is empty. No people, repaired drive, tow cable, supplies, furniture or recovery items.
